test.title: Binomial Theorem - Test 6
test.description: Previous Year Questions as Chapter Test
test.syllabus: This test contains questions from all topics of this chapter included in the JEE Main syllabus. It includes a mix of questions from PYQs of JEE Main 2019 - 2025.

question.text: The coefficient of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mn>2012</mn></msup></math> in the expansion of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mfenced><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>-</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow></mfenced><mn>2008</mn></msup><msup><mfenced><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mo>+</mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></mfenced><mn>2007</mn></msup></math> is equal to _____.

If the term without <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math> in the expansion of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mfenced><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mfrac><mn>2</mn><mn>3</mn></mfrac></msup><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mi>α</mi><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup></mfrac></mrow></mfenced><mn>22</mn></msup></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>7315</mn><mo> </mo></math>, then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced open="|" close="|"><mi>α</mi></mfenced></math> is equal to _____ .
The ratio of the coefficient of the middle term in the expansion of (1+x)20 and the sum of the coefficients of two middle terms in expansion of (1+x)19 is           .

Let the sixth term in the binomial expansion of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mfenced><mrow><msqrt><msup><mn>2</mn><mrow><msub><mi>log</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mfenced><mrow><mn>10</mn><mo>-</mo><msup><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi></msup></mrow></mfenced></mrow></msup></msqrt><mo>+</mo><mroot><msup><mn>2</mn><mrow><mo>(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>)</mo><msub><mi>log</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup><mn>5</mn></mroot></mrow></mfenced><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></msup></math> powers of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mn>2</mn><mrow><mfenced><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfenced><msub><mi>log</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup></math>, be <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>21</mn></math> . If the binomial coefficients of the second, third and fourth terms in the expansion are respectively the first, third and fifth terms of an A.P., then the sum of the squares of all possible values of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math> is _____ .

The number of rational terms in the binomial expansion of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mfenced><mrow><msup><mn>4</mn><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>4</mn></mfrac></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mn>5</mn><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>6</mn></mfrac></msup></mrow></mfenced><mn>120</mn></msup></math>is_______.

If the coefficient of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>10</mn></msup></math> in the binomial expansion of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mfenced><mrow><mfrac><msqrt><mi>x</mi></msqrt><msup><mn>5</mn><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>4</mn></mfrac></msup></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mfrac><msqrt><mn>5</mn></msqrt><msup><mi>x</mi><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>3</mn></mfrac></msup></mfrac></mrow></mfenced><mn>60</mn></msup></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mn>5</mn><mi>k</mi></msup><mi>l</mi></math>, where <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>l</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>N</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>l</mi></math> is coprime to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>5</mn></math>, then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>k</mi></math> is equal to ______.

If <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mfrac><msup><mn>3</mn><mn>6</mn></msup><msup><mn>4</mn><mn>4</mn></msup></mfrac></mfenced><mi>k</mi></math> is the term, independent of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo></math> in the binomial expansion of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mfenced><mrow><mfrac><mi>x</mi><mn>4</mn></mfrac><mo>-</mo><mfrac><mn>12</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mfrac></mrow></mfenced><mn>12</mn></msup><mo>,</mo></math> then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>k</mi></math> is equal to

Let the coefficients of three consecutive terms in the binomial expansion of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><msup><mo>)</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi></msup></math> be in the ratio <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mo>:</mo><mo> </mo><mn>5</mn><mo>:</mo><mo> </mo><mn>8</mn></math>. Then the coefficient of the term, which is in the middle of these three terms, is

If the coefficients of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math> in the expansion of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mfenced><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfenced><mi>p</mi></msup><msup><mfenced><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>-</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfenced><mi>q</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><mi>p</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>q</mi><mo>≤</mo><mn>15</mn></math>, are <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>-</mo><mn>5</mn></math> respectively, then the coefficient of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup></math> is equal to ______.

If the constant term, in binomial expansion of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mfenced><mrow><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mi>r</mi></msup><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mfrac></mrow></mfenced><mn>10</mn></msup></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>180</mn><mo>,</mo></math> then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>r</mi></math> is equal to ____________.

Let the coefficients of third, fourth and fifth terms in the expansion of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mfenced><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mi>a</mi><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mfrac></mrow></mfenced><mi>n</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>x</mi><mo>≠</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo></math> be in the ratio <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>12</mn><mo>:</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>:</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>.</mo></math> Then the term independent of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math> in the expansion, is equal to _______.

In the expansion of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfenced><mfenced><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></mfenced><msup><mfenced><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mn>3</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup></mfrac></mrow></mfenced><mn>5</mn></msup><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>x</mi><mo>≠</mo><mn>0</mn></math>, the sum of the coefficient of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>13</mn></mrow></msup></math> is equal to ______

Let <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced open="[" close="]"><mi>t</mi></mfenced></math> denote the greatest integer <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>≤</mo><mi>t</mi></math>. if the constant term in the expansion of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mfenced><mrow><mn>3</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>-</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>5</mn></msup></mrow></mfrac></mrow></mfenced><mn>7</mn></msup></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>α</mi></math> then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced open="[" close="]"><mi>α</mi></mfenced></math> is equal to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>_</mi><mi>_</mi><mi>_</mi><mi>_</mi><mi>_</mi></math>

If the coefficient of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>30</mn></msup></math> in the expansion of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mfenced><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mi>x</mi></mfrac></mrow></mfenced><mn>6</mn></msup><msup><mfenced><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></mfenced><mn>7</mn></msup><msup><mfenced><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup></mrow></mfenced><mn>8</mn></msup><mo>;</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>≠</mo><mn>0</mn></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>α</mi></math>, then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced close="|" open="|"><mi>α</mi></mfenced></math> equals _________.

Let <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>α</mi></math> be the constant term in the binomial expansion of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mfenced><mrow><msqrt><mi>x</mi></msqrt><mo>-</mo><mfrac><mn>6</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mfrac><mn>3</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac></msup></mfrac></mrow></mfenced><mi>n</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>≤</mo><mn>15</mn><mo>.</mo></math> If the sum of the coefficients of the remaining terms in the expansion is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>649</mn></math> and the coefficient of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mi>n</mi></mrow></msup></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>λ</mi><mi>α</mi><mo>,</mo></math> then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>λ</mi></math> is equal to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>_</mi><mi>_</mi><mi>_</mi><mi>_</mi><mi>_</mi><mi>_</mi><mi>_</mi><mi>_</mi><mo>.</mo></math>
If the second, third and fourth terms in the expansion of $(x+y)^n$ are 135,30 and $\frac{10}{3}$, respectively, then $6\left(n^3+x^2+y\right)$ is equal to _______
